description.value: Through careful preparation, you can weave two separate effects into a single ritual.

system.benefits: You may combine two weaves into a single, longer ritual. Both weaves use the half-Energy cost benefit. When the ritual completes, both effects trigger simultaneously. They may have different targets. You make separate weaving and targeting rolls for each weave.

usage.text: Applies to Ritual Casting only; ritual takes 20 minutes
